title: Hood suppression inspection overdue after flare-up on grill #1
description: Grease flare-up reached the hood on grill #1 during Saturday service. The suppression inspection sticker expired last month. Vendor needs to inspect before Friday; until then no high-flame searing on grill #1.

title: Grill #2 igniter replaced
description: Igniter clicking but not lighting. Replaced by vendor.

title: Walk-in door closer broken
description: Door does not close on its own. Closer replaced.

title: Stand mixer paddle cracked
description: Crack near the shaft; replacement paddle ordered and installed.

title: Fryer oil down to 1 case — delivery was short
description: Harbor Foodservice delivered 2 of 6 cases of canola frying oil. After the Wednesday change we have 1 case left; par is 4. We will run out by Saturday dinner without an order.

title: POS modifier order — allergy on the top line
description: Follow-up from the Table 12 near-miss.

title: Salamander slow to heat on the pass side
description: Takes ~25 min to reach temp in the morning, used to be 10. Right burner looks weaker than the left.

title: Fryer #1 thermostat overshooting to 390°F
description: Thermostat replaced; calibrated at 350°F.

title: Fryer oil changes skipped two nights running
description: Fryer log shows no change Monday or Tuesday; TPM read 27% this morning. Close checklist was signed anyway. Need to find out who is closing fry and retrain on the change schedule.

title: Grill ticket printer jams during rush
description: Printer jams on long tickets (8+ items). Blocked: waiting on POS vendor to ship a replacement cutter.

title: Missing sheet trays
description: Found in the pastry rack; labelled by station.

title: Flat-top has a cold spot front-left
description: Front-left quarter of the flat-top reads 90°F lower than the rest. Burgers there are coming out under temp. Using the back half only for now.

title: Ice machine output low
description: Filter replaced, output back to spec.

title: Grill short-staffed for Friday dinner (2 of 4 cooks)
description: Two grill cooks called out for Friday. Need two cover shifts or a reduced grill menu. Shift scheduler shows no one available yet.

title: Replace worn grill brushes
description: Two of three grill brushes are shedding bristles. Bristles on grates are a foreign-object hazard.

title: Update walk-in alarm contact list
description: Alarm now pages the KM and both sous chefs.

title: Blast chiller not pulling down — chili hit 88°F at the 2 h check
description: Blast chiller shows error E4 and cannot bring a 6 gal chili batch below 70°F within 2 hours. Batch was reheated and re-cooled with ice wands. Until fixed, all cooling must use ice baths + ice wands in 2-in pans. Vendor visit needed.

title: Label printer printing blank date field
description: Day-dot labels print with the use-by date empty. Hand-writing dates for now.

title: Charbroiler grates warped
description: Two grates replaced.

title: Walk-in reading 43°F at 6 AM check
description: Display 43°F, probe in the milk 42°F. Door closer is slow again. Product moved per the alarm SOP; vendor called.

title: Host stand tablet charger missing
description: New charger mounted under the stand.

title: Croissants over-proofing in the new proofer
description: Since the proofer was replaced, croissants collapse at the 2 h mark. Recipe card still has the old proofer settings.

title: Order more disposable piping bags
description: Down to half a box of 18-in bags.

title: Vacuum sealer not sealing on one side
description: Right side of the seal bar leaves an open corner. Heat strip may need replacing.

title: Oven #3 hot spot back-right
description: Financiers in the back-right position are dark on the bottom. Rotating trays at 6 min as a workaround.

title: Colour codes on cutting boards worn off
description: Several boards have lost their colour tabs, including one purple (allergen) board. Replace before the next audit.

title: Proofer replaced — update settings card
description: New proofer installed. Settings card on the door updated; recipe card still pending.

title: Chicken stock yield down to 26 qt
description: Last three batches yielded 26–27 qt instead of 32. Suspect simmer too hard overnight.

title: Squeeze bottles cracked
description: Replaced 12 bottles.

title: Mandoline guard missing
description: Guard found and re-attached with a tether.

title: Dish machine sanitizer reading 30 ppm
description: Chlorine strip read 30 ppm at shift start (min 50). Re-primed once, still low. Using the 3-compartment sink.

title: Reprint allergen menu cards (sesame added)
description: Sesame needs to be on the allergen matrix card at the host stand.

title: Expo heat lamp bulb out
description: Left bulb over the pass is out.

title: Guest reaction — sesame not on menu matrix
description: Mild reaction, guest OK. Sesame added to allergen matrix.

title: Cooling log missing 6 h entries
description: Log retraining done at pre-shift.

title: Label gun jammed
description: Cleared and cleaned.

title: Hood filter missing from bank 2
description: Filter was in the dish pit; reinstalled.

title: Replace wet floor signs
description: Two new signs at the dish pit.

title: Stockpot handle loose
description: Rivets replaced.

title: Gas smell near the line — valve tightened
description: Utility checked, fitting tightened, no leak on re-test.
